PQC Hybrid ML-KEM-768 SIPREC Escrow & Voiceprint Crypto-Shredding
X25519+ML-KEM-768 + >21.85m SRTP ROC Rollover / >=500ms Dual-MKI (P765) & Per-Subject DEK Crypto-Shredding <=5s + BIPA <=1095d (P766)
1. PQC Hybrid ML-KEM-768 SIPREC & SRTP ROC Rollover Gate (P765)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Classical ECDHE Only & >21.85min SRTP ROC Desync
• Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) breaks 7-to-10yr MiFID/HIPAA SIPREC archives
• At 21.85m (seq 65535->0), packet loss desyncs SRTP ROC -> white noise static
• Single-MKI 60m DTLS-SRTP rekey drops in-flight packets during key rotation
✅ Production Pattern: X25519MLKEM768 + ROC+-1 Trial & Dual-MKI (P765)
1. NIST FIPS 203 Hybrid KEM: X25519 + ML-KEM-768 (>=768 lattice rank) on SIPREC
2. SRTP RFC 3711 ROC+-1 Trial Decrypt: Resyncs 16-bit seq wrap across loss
3. >=500ms Dual-MKI Rekey Window: Accepts old & new keys during rotation
4. Multi-Hour Call Survival: 0% static/lockout at 21.85m, 43.7m, and 60m marks
Deterministic Invariant (evaluatePqcHybridMlkem768SiprecEscrow...):
mlkemParameterSet >= 768 && dualMkiOverlapWindowMs >= 500ms
2. Per-Subject Voiceprint Crypto-Shredding & BIPA/GDPR Gate (P766)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Shared Table Key & Orphaned Voiceprints in WORM Backups
• SQL DELETE removes active row, but voiceprint stays in 7-yr immutable backups!
• Shared tenant KMS key cannot be destroyed without wiping all other customers
• Result: GDPR Art. 17 erasure failure & $5,000/call Illinois BIPA class-action
✅ Production Pattern: Per-Subject DEK Crypto-Shredding + BIPA Gate (P766)
1. Unique Per-Subject DEK: Each caller's d-vector encrypted with dedicated DEK
2. Instant Crypto-Shredding (<=5,000ms): Purge DEK in HSM -> WORM copies dead
3. Explicit BIPA/CUBI Consent Gate: Zero biometric extraction prior to opt-in
4. Statutory Retention Ceiling: Auto-shred after <=1,095 days (3 years)
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSovereignVoiceprintPerSubject...):
perSubjectDek=true && shredSlaMs<=5000ms && maxRetentionDays<=1095d
